chars.M: MOUNIR: a 24-year-old man wearing a slim charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, burgundy tie and black shoes.
chars.B: BOY: a small 8-year-old boy wearing a bright yellow hoodie, blue jeans and a blue school backpack.
chars.T: TEACHER: a young woman teacher wearing a soft pink hijab and a long white teacher's coat over a lavender dress, holding a red whiteboard marker.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan electronics shop with phones and chargers on shelves. BOY stands crying loudly with big tears, pointing at his red cheek; MOUNIR behind the counter leans forward, shocked and getting angry. Comic exaggerated expressions.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the electronics shop, BOY hides his face in MOUNIR's arm, scared and sobbing; MOUNIR pats his head with a frown.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the electronics shop, MOUNIR kneels with both hands on BOY's shoulders, determined face, promising; BOY wipes his tears.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a modest Moroccan apartment hallway, MOUNIR straightens his burgundy tie in front of a mirror, proud and serious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan city street in front of a primary school gate with a green door and a Moroccan flag; MOUNIR marches angrily with big steps holding BOY's hand, BOY runs to keep up.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan primary school courtyard with blue and white tiled walls; MOUNIR shakes an angry fist in the air, BOY behind him looking nervous.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A school corridor with classroom doors; MOUNIR strides furiously toward a classroom door, BOY pointing at the door.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At a classroom doorway: TEACHER turns around smiling gently; MOUNIR freezes mid-step, jaw dropped, his angry fist melting, little hearts floating near him; BOY looks up at him confused. Comic.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan classroom with a whiteboard and wooden desks, TEACHER stands holding the red marker; MOUNIR stares at her completely charmed, tie loosened, forgetting why he came.
